# About Us

**Elite Commercial Door, Inc.** is a state licensed & insured premier company for ALL of your commercial door needs.  We can tackle your automatic, storefront or manual door projects, whether it's service, repairs or new installation!

### [CONTACT US](/#contact-us) TODAY!

**[REQUEST SERVICE NOW](https://form.jotform.com/253285903245156)**

**WE ARE HIRING!  INQUIRE AT JOBS@ELITE-DOOR.COM**

**[VISIT US ON LINKEDIN](https://www.linkedin.com/company/elite-commercial-door-inc./)**

locationCard.title: STATE-WIDE SERVICE
locationCard.description: We have offices & crews on the East Coast and West Coast of Florida!  East Coast counties include Palm Beach, Broward & Palm Beach County.  On the West Coast, we can service Collier, Hendry, Lee, Charlotte Sarasota & Manatee County.  If you're outside these counties, don't hesitate to contact us!  We can travel state-wide.

businessCard.title: 25 Years
businessCard.description: We are a family owned & operated business of 11 years, with over 25 years in the commercial door industry.

serviceCard.title: Service & Installation
serviceCard.description:
We can service and install Automatic Door assemblies, manual & steel door assemblies, storefront assemblies and all respective hardware.

Our automatic door technicians are *AAADM* Certified, with a wealth of knowledge & experience in various manufacturers.
